reviews.x: Tried under my eyes everyday for a week and didn’t notice anything. Switched to my whole face (per the instructions on the bottle) and had a major breakout.

I was looking for a more natural product. I was not expecting a list of 20+ ingredients that I can't pronounce. Don't see Retinol at all in the ingredients.  But I will give it a chance. Too early to know how good it is.

This has been the best retinol face serum I’ve used so far. It is a bit strong so I apply a moisturizer first to prevent skin sinsevity. Initially I got a sunburn sensation on my skin but i stopped for a few days and started again with moisturizer underneath. It tightens my facial pores and gives my face a nice glow. Not sure about reducing wrinkles or peelings yet. I’m half way through first bottle. It comes in two. I will continue applying it. You can check back with me in a month.

I’ve been using it for about two weeks and so far I really like it. I started off applying it once a day every other day and now I’m applying it daily. I like that it absorbs quickly so you can use other products with it. I don’t know if the difference is noticeable but I do think my skin feels nicer.
I have very sensitive skin, but I can say the product works wonderful on my skin.  It feels super smoth and the pores are visible minimize on my face.
I do like this product, and i think it is good value for money. I would purchase again.
I did not like it. It gave red spots on face

reviews.t: The best bang for your buck
reviews.x: This retinol serum is the first product I’ve ever been able to put on my face that didn’t cause break out. The product actually keeps my skin so clear, ever since I started using it about a year ago I have not had any acne or dry skin patches at all.  My skin is so smooth and soft. I have recommended it to many friends.

reviews.t: New Sealed Package Product Gone Bad
reviews.x: Bought these duo. Used the first one, product itself is okay. Opened this 2nd bottle to use today but noticed that its formula is different or has changed, product doesn’t expire until next year. I shook the bottle to see if it would mix, but it didn’t. Looks like mucus. Disgusting. Can I please exchange for a new one?

The purpose of this serum is to thicken the skin.  You can not do that by moisturizing.  I am 70, and am noticing a difference in my skin.  I worked for a dermatologist/plastic surgeon in the past.  I have used 1% retin a in the past as well.  This serum does as well and is less drying.

Used it for about a week. Product has a burning sensation after a few days of use. Am now using it only at nights.  Serum tightens but not sure if it moisturizes much. I usually use my day or night moisturizer with it.  Will continue to use to see results.

claims.text: Many reviewers report positive results such as minimized pores, firmer skin, reduced wrinkles, and more even tone.
Several users find the product gentle and fast-absorbing, even on sensitive skin, though some note it can be strong and cause irritation or breakouts.
A few reviewers saw no noticeable improvement after weeks of use.
Some reviewers question the ingredient list, expecting more natural ingredients or noting retinol isn't clearly listed.
A couple of reviewers consider it good value and would repurchase.
